posts.zh:
dsh-office-plugin 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。把多 agent 会话的实时活动渲染成 Web UI 侧边栏里的像素风办公室--每个会话是一名牛/马员工，忙时伏案敲键盘、闲时起身摸鱼，支持点击查看工位监控、就地处理审批。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-2cea9932d168691fd10c.html
posts.en:
dsh-office-plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Renders live multi-agent session activity as a pixel-art office in a Web UI side panel - each session is an ox/horse worker typing at its desk when busy or wandering off when idle, with click-to-view work monitors and in-place approval cards.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-2cea9932d168691fd10c.html
